title: Largest BST Subtree
statement: Given an array of integers `arr` and an integer `si`, find the maximum value of all subarrays of size `si`. A subarray is a contiguous subset of the array. Return a list of these maximum values in the order they appear. For example, given the array `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` and `si = 3`, the maximum values of all subarrays of size `3` are `[3, 4, 5]` because the subarrays are `[1, 2, 3]`, `[2, 3, 4]`, and `[3, 4, 5]`, and their maximum values are `3`, `4`, and `5` respectively.
